targets.text: A MADHAVI
Role: Business Analyst
madhavi.aradhyula03@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/madhavi-av-a3ba34b0
Professional Summary
Results-driven professional with 8 years of experience in business analysis, product ownership, and quality assurance
within the digital payments industry. Hands-on exposure to requirement gathering, writing user stories, acceptance
criteria, and functional documentation (BRD/FSD). Experienced in collaborating with stakeholders and technical teams
to support gap analysis, process flows, and payment system implementations. Currently enhancing BA expertise while
leveraging strong payments domain knowledge and Agile/Scrum experience to bridge business and technology needs
effectively. Experienced in digital payments systems, including cards (ATM & POS),Tokenization, IMPS, UPI, AEPS, NEFT,
RTGS, SWIFT, and cross-border payment solutions, with hands-on knowledge of transaction flows, clearing and
Settlement.
Key Competencies
Technical Skills
Business Analysis & Requirement Gathering
BRD/FSD Documentation and Writing User Stories
Stakeholder & Vendor Management
Process Modelling (AS-IS / TO-BE)
Agile & Scrum (CSPO Certified)
Payment Switch Migration
Regulatory & Compliance Requirements
Product Ownership & Backlog Management
Operating Systems: Linux, Windows
Testing Tools: FINSIM, BOSS, MSGSIM, T3, Postman
Databases: Oracle, Postgres, Redis,Cassandra
Messaging Queues: Kafka
Payment Switches: IST Switch, Bharat Switch, Nexus
Defect Tracking Tools: JIRA, ALM, Excel
Web Servers : Apache Tomcat9, Nginx
Collabration Tools : Confluence, Teams
BPMN Tools : Draw.io, MS Visio
Professional Experience
Company : Tech Mahindra | Business Analyst cum UAT Tester
Duration: Aug 2022 – Present | Location: Hyderabad| Client: Mastercard | Project: SMT-Validator
and Mastercard Nexus Switch Migration
Key Responsibilities:
Gathered, analyzed, and documented business requirements.
Converted requirements into user stories, Prepared functional workflows.
Executed test plans and validated transaction processing across payment systems for Authorization flows which
includes ATM,POS,MDES transactions.
Supported QA and Regression team for testing after each build deployment.
Facilitated defect triage sessions with development teams.
Provided daily test execution status updates to senior management.
Participate in Scrum meetings and backlog grooming.
Worked on Cross Border Payments for Cards and Non-Card based Payments.
Trained new hires on Payment Switch Migration Flows.
Worked on Payment Rails like Cards, SWIFT (MT103,MT202,MT202COV).
Company : Pine Labs | Sr QA Cum Product Owner
Duration: Jan 2022 – June 2022 | Location: Hyderabad | Project: PayLater Mastercard Installments (BNPL)
Key Responsibilities:
Owned product backlog and prioritized features based on business needs.
Collaborated with development teams to define functional specifications.
Led end-to-end integration testing for BNPL solutions.
Managed stakeholder expectations and communication.
Oversaw UAT and production deployment.
Conducted root cause analysis on production issues.
Company : Capgemini | Consultant
Duration: May 2021 – Dec 2021 | Location: Hyderabad | Project: Core Banking & Retail Processing System
Key Responsibilities:
Gathered and analyzed business requirements, translating them into BRDs, FSDs, user stories, and acceptance
criteria for core banking modules and retail payment workflows.
Conducted gap analysis, impact assessments, and process mapping to support system modernization and
compliance initiatives.
Collaborated with technical teams, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors to ensure accurate requirement
translation and solution alignment.
Assisted in UAT, functional testing, and validation of transactions across SWIFT MT103,MT202,MT202COV, NEFT,
and RTGS payment systems.
Created process diagrams, flowcharts, and documentation to communicate workflows, system changes, and
technical designs effectively.
Company : National Payments Corporation of India | Senior Associate
Duration: Jan 2017 – May 2021 | Location: Hyderabad
Key Projects:
Upgradation of AEPS Services from V2.0 to V2.5
IMPS Service Migration from IST to Bharat Switch(UPI Common Code)
Integration of FRM Module
Migration of Payment Switch from ITM to IST
Implementation of LM Service for ATM, IMPS, and AEPS
Implementation of Fraud Detection system
Certification Testing with member banks
Worked on Tag Mapping to Element level mapping for IMPS.
Key Responsibilities:
Gathered, analyzed, and documented business, functional, and technical requirements for payment switch
migration projects.
Performed gap analysis between legacy and new payment switch systems to identify discrepancies.
Designed AS-IS and TO-BE process flows for transaction authorization, routing, clearing, settlement, and
reconciliation.
Defined business rules for transaction life-cycles, authorization, clearing, and settlement workflows.
Supported payment gateway integration's, API-based solutions, and fraud detection mechanisms.
Conducted load and stress testing to validate switch performance under peak transaction volumes.
Coordinated production environment setup and facilitated handover sessions with production teams during switch
migration.
Collaborated with vendors to clarify requirements, ensuring on-time delivery of system integration's.
Designed and executed functional and integration test cases, validating ISO8583 message formats and end-to-end
flows.
Managed defects using JIRA and Excel, ensuring timely resolution and retesting.
Provided post-migration support by monitoring transaction success rates, system performance, and error handling.
Conducted root cause analysis (RCA) on production issues, implementing corrective actions.
Worked on IMPS migration from ISO8583 protocol to ISO20022 XML protocol(similar).
Acted as a liaison with banks, resolving technical queries and suggesting improvements for product efficiency.
Certifications
Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), 2025
Fundamentals of SWIFT MT & ISO20022 – MVLCO, 2020
Trained in Embedded Systems – Vector India, 2016
Education
Bachelor of Engineering in ECE – Gayatri Vidya Parishad, Andhra University, Visakhapatnam, India (2015)
Hobbies
Reading Books, Writing blogs

targets.text: AJAY KUMAR CHAUDHARI
mEmail ID: ajaymit007@yahoo.com | Linkedin: www.linkedin.com/in/ajaykchaudhari | Location: Pune
SUMMARY
Product Owner with 13+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale product strategy, digital transformation,
and regulatory initiatives across Payments, Wholesale Banking, and Retail Banking domains. Proven expertise in
delivering complex payment solutions including Cross-Border Payments, ACH, Wire Transfers, SWIFT MT/MX
Messaging, ISO 20022 Migration, Clearing & Settlement, and Real-Time Payment ecosystems.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Technology in Information Technology, 2006-2010, from Uttar Pradesh Technical University, UP
CORE SKILLS
✓ Key Skills - Product Ownership & Product Strategy | SAFe Agile | Scrum | RTB | CTB | Product Roadmap |
Program Increment (PI) Planning | Business Analysis | Requirement Management | Epic | User Story Creation
& Acceptance Criteria | Product Backlog and Refinement | Product Demo | Stakeholder and Executive
Management | Cross-Functional Team Leadership | RAID Management | Risk Management
✓ Domain Expertise - Wholesale Banking | Issuer Services | Retail Banking | Payments - Cross-Border
Payments, Real-Time Payments (RTP), ACH & Wire Payments | ISO 20022 Migration & Transformation -
✓ Delivery & Transformation - End to End Product Delivery | UAT Coordination and Sign-off | Change
Management | Workflow Automation | Data Analysis and Reporting | KPI & Performance Metrics
✓ Business Transformation & Architecture -AS-IS / TO-BE Analysis | Target Operating Model (TOM) |
Business Process Mapping | Process Re-engineering | Business Capability Mapping | Process
Optimization | Transformation Roadmaps | Customer Journey Mapping | Gap Analysis | Operating
✓ Tools, Technology & Products - JIRA | Confluence | MS Visio | MS Office Suite | Generative AI | API
Integration | | JSON/XML payloads and Validations | SQL | Database | ERP | CRM | FINNONE | VMS |
SWIFT MT/MX Messaging | Clearing & Settlement | Fintech
Model Transformation
ODYSSEY| RET
ORGANIZATIONAL EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst
✓ Designed and implemented change management strategies that improve adoption rates and delivered
the enhance version of CRM application to various clients.
Virtusa Consulting Service Private Limited | Pune
1. Client – CITI Bank | Product Owner | (October 2025 to Till Now)
October2021-Present
Key Roles:
✓ Responsible for CITI Global Regulatory Event Tracking product ownership and strategy including defining
product vision, roadmap and strategic objectives.
✓ Actively participated in PI planning activities and all scrum ceremonies.
✓ Facilitating requirement workshops, peer discussion and gathering detailed requirements from multiple
stakeholders.
✓ Translating regulatory requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
✓ Generative AI Use Case Identification for RET Product.
✓ Responsible for backlog refinements and prioritization.
✓ Act as primary bridge between business stakeholders, development and delivery team.
✓ Collaborate closely with engineering team to remove critical blockers, and ensure timely delivery of features.
✓ Supporting UAT to ensure successful feature delivery.
✓ Coordinate with other POs, Scrum Masters, and the Release Train Engineer (RTE) across the Agile Release Train
(ART) to manage cross team dependencies mitigate the risks.
✓ Document and maintain product artifacts like Steer-co, RAID log etc.
✓ Tracking production issues, identify root cause and coordinating with support team for issue resolution.
✓ Tracking KPIs and accomplishments and delivery milestones.
✓ Strong exposure to both Change-the-Bank (CTB) and Run-the-Bank (RTB) operating models, with a sound
appreciation of production stability, operational controls, and risk management
✓ Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to
engage confidently with senior business stakeholders, technology leads, and external partners.
2. Client – HSBC | Agile Business Analyst | (October 2021 to October 2025)
Key Roles:
✓ Facilitated requirements workshops and prepared functional requirements documents, working closely
with Product, Business and Technology stakeholders.
✓ Gathered requirements and created user stories, use cases, process flows and mock-ups.
✓ Performed functional testing and facilitated UAT with business users; conducted walkthroughs and
supported SIT/UAT execution.
✓ Performed gap analysis and developed roadmaps for application enhancements and transformation
initiatives.
✓ Supported Target Operating Model (TOM) transformation for payment processing, defining future-state
process responsibilities, business/technology hand-offs, operational controls and system interactions
across payment initiation, processing, clearing and settlement.
✓ Conducted detailed AS-IS process analysis across cross-border payments, ACH, Wire, SWIFT and ISO
20022 payment flows, documenting current-state processes, business rules, system interactions, hand-offs
and operational pain points.
✓ Performed AS-IS vs. TO-BE gap analysis to identify process, system, data and operational gaps and
translated findings into business requirements, user stories and transformation initiatives.
✓ Designed and documented TO-BE process flows for payment migration and automation initiatives,
identifying process simplification opportunities, changes in system responsibilities and opportunities to
improve straight-through processing.
✓ Performed Business Capability Mapping for payment transformation initiatives, linking payment
capabilities across initiation, validation, processing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation and exception
management to supporting processes and technology components.
✓ Led requirements workshops for critical banking transformation projects including US Transtar Migration,
Cross-Border Payments, ACH, Wire, SWIFT, CT Account Automation, Repack Reporting, ISO 20022/SWIFT
Migration, DTCC and clearing-house initiatives.
Key Deliverables:
✓ Supported legacy-to-target platform transformation by analysing AS-IS processes, identifying functional and
operational gaps, defining TO-BE workflows and translating target-state requirements into business/user
stories while addressing customer, regulatory and compliance requirements.
Implemented US payment solutions covering ACH and Wire, along with ISO 20022-aligned corporate-action
messaging across HK, UK, US and Singapore.
✓ Led functional analysis for cross-border payment and cash-account automation, mapping AS-IS payment flows
and defining TO-BE workflows across SWIFT messaging, HUB-Hadoop integration and Odyssey, including
business rules, system interactions, exception handling and operational hand-offs.
Implemented cross-border payment flows involving MT103 and MT202 and supported cash-account
automation through HUB-Hadoop/Odyssey integration.

1. Client – ICICI HFC | Business Analyst | (October 2018 to July 2021)
October2018–July2021
Key Roles:
✓ Led requirements workshops, translating complex business needs into functional specifications for
critical banking projects like Loan Origination & Servicing, Customer On boarding, Vendor Management
System.
✓ Facilitating requirements workshops and preparing business requirements documents.
✓ Working closely with technology and business stakeholders to ensure the project deliverables.
✓ Responsible for creating Use Stories and Use Cases, Sequence Flow, and DFDs.
✓ Performing functional testing and facilitating user acceptance testing (UAT) with business user.
✓ Facilitating end user training & centralized user management activity and master data management.
✓ Performing gaps analysis and devising a road map for enhancing applications & ensuring a
smooth implementation.
✓ Mapped AS-IS customer onboarding and lending processes, identifying manual activities,
process gaps and system dependencies and defining TO-BE workflows for digital onboarding,
eligibility checks, approvals and loan disbursement.
✓ Designed future-state payment processing workflows for the Vendor Management System, covering UPI-
based domestic payments, validation, approval and downstream processing.
✓ Responsible for production support activity and deployments.
✓ Successfully delivered digital solutions resulting in measurable cost savings and improved process
transparency.
Key Deliverables:
✓ Mapped the end-to-end customer onboarding journey for the HFC Mobility application, covering
customer acquisition, eligibility checks, approval and loan disbursement, and identified process
improvements to support a smoother digital experience.
✓ Delivered HFC Vendor management system that on boarded 5000+ sales & channel partners and
managed their sales, invoice and domestic payment solutions including UPI, collaborating with
cross-functional teams to define end-to-end payment processing .
✓ Maintained master data mapping for various application like APS / Finnone / VMS / FMCANVAS / CRMnext.
✓ Hands-on experience working on different rule engines and process automation tools and techniques.

targets.text: Sungard – Senior Project Manager | January 2016 – April 2019
❖ Delivered end-to-end payment platforms using ISO 8583 and ISO 20022 standards, enabling secure, scalable, and high-volume transaction
processing systems.
❖ Managed cross-border and domestic payment flows including SWIFT (MT103, MT202) and SEPA (pain.001, pacs.008), ensuring compliance,
accuracy, and seamless settlement.
❖ Applied Agile planning, bottom-up estimation, and resource forecasting to ensure predictable delivery timelines and optimal utilization of
project resources.
❖ Collaborated with engineering and API teams to ensure seamless integration and orchestration of payment transactions across enterprise
systems and gateways.
❖ Resolved complex payment failures including duplicates, timeouts, and formatting errors, improving system reliability and transaction
success rates.
❖ Strong exposure to API-level integrations, including REST API coordination, Swagger/API documentation review, request-response
validation, integration testing support, defect triaging, and end-to-end system integration management.
❖ Experience collaborating with Development, QA, Product Owners, HR teams, and business stakeholders to drive project execution, resource
planning, defect management, and delivery governance.
Telefonica – Defect Manager / Test Architect | December 2014 – December 2015
❖ Led end-to-end defect lifecycle management across mobile (2G–5G) and enterprise systems ensuring structured tracking, prioritization, and
timely resolution of critical issues.
❖ Supported product enhancements across claims, payments, authorization workflows, and benefits systems ensuring smooth delivery of
customer-facing features.
❖ Managed Agile backlog, roadmap, and release planning using Jira and Confluence to ensure transparency, governance, and delivery
alignment.
❖ Collaborated with UX, QA, engineering, and business teams to ensure requirement clarity, design validation, and synchronized execution of
releases.
Identified risks and delivery bottlenecks proactively and implemented mitigation strategies to ensure on-time and quality-driven delivery
outcomes.
❖ Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new domains, understand complex business workflows, stakeholder expectations, compliance
requirements, and drive successful project outcomes in Agile environments.
Datamatics – Test Lead | August 2008 – November 2014
❖ Defined comprehensive test strategies covering functional, regression, integration, and system testing ensuring high-quality delivery
aligned with business requirements.
❖ Led end-to-end testing activities for healthcare insurance applications, including policy administration, member enrollment, claims
processing, provider management, and customer portals.
❖ Managed a team of 8–12 QA engineers across onsite and offshore locations, ensuring timely delivery of testing milestones.
❖ Developed test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and test cases based on business requirements and functional specifications.
❖ Coordinated Functional, System Integration (SIT), Regression, User Acceptance (UAT), and End-to-End testing across multiple releases.
❖ Collaborated with business analysts, developers, product owners, and stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve production issues.
❖ Managed defect lifecycle using Jira/ALM, conducted defect triage meetings, and ensured timely resolution of critical issues.
❖ Automated regression test suites using Selenium WebDriver and integrated automated execution into CI/CD pipelines where applicable.
❖ Validated REST/SOAP APIs using Postman and SOAP UI and performed backend database validation using SQL.
❖ Generated daily status reports, quality metrics, test execution dashboards, and release readiness reports for senior management.
❖ Mentored QA team members on testing best practices, Agile processes, and quality standards.
Implemented risk-based testing approaches to improve test coverage while reducing execution time.
Improved release quality by reducing production defects through proactive risk identification, root cause analysis, and continuous process
improvements

Designation: Network Engineers
Client:Société Generale Global Solution|| 3M India
28th Apr’21 to 16th July 26
Roles and Responsibilities
1)Join calls with customer to understand their requirement.

firewall,router,switches,ethernet (copper,fiber optics 10/40/100G).

implementation.

10)Manage the delivery include validation, approval, feasibility, target delivery timeliness and
implementation of order as per customer requirement.
and ensure new equipment is registered and added to the inventory management system

13)Handle day to day security P3 and P4 incidents.
14)Working closely with partner management teams to such as Verizon, AT&T,
SingTel,Telstra,OBS,COLT for provisioning new circuits activation and deactivation within
SLA.
and proper destruction and decommission of existing network device such as FortiGate
firewall,router,switches
15)Timely completion of given activity and to generate daily link utilization report with SLA
achievement more than 95%
